identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Persist provenance for title-only issue updates

values.goal: Make title-only typed issue updates durably attributable and truthfully reconciled without changing unrelated issue body content.
values.required_outcome: A title-only update preserves the prior body, durably records its operation key, and reports reconciliation only after exact readback proves title and provenance.
authority_boundary: Typed owner remains the mutation authority
No lifecycle or card authority changes
